## Final checkpoint

**Done and real:**
- The 9 Z.AI files are deployed at `/opt/veridian/scripts/prompt_gateway/` (entrypoint renamed `gateway.py`), live on the server, committed and pushed in [PR #60](https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/60).
- **Collision avoided**: `/opt/veridian/scripts/task-gateway.py` is verified byte-for-byte unchanged (sha256 `1e9421...ca9a49b`, 642 lines, identical before/after).
- `--mode init` ran for real, exit 0 — created real dirs under `/opt/veridian/data/prompt_gateway/`, seeded 6 snippets, generated+parsed a real VD- id.
- Full E2E proven: piped a realistic owner instruction through `--mode stdin --json-only` → real 66.7% token reduction, 13.2% noise reduction, correct CODE/FIX classification, and validated (not executed) composition into `task-gateway.py submit --text ... --source owner --session-id ...`.
- Along the way I found and fixed a real bug (not just a rename job): `TaskGateway.__init__` was hardcoding data/snippet paths off `VERIDIAN_BASE` directly, bypassing `config.py`'s namespacing and writing to bare `/opt/veridian/data`/`/opt/veridian/snippets` — caught by actually inspecting what `--mode init` wrote to disk, not by code review alone.
- VD- id namespace, systemd non-install reasoning, and full file layout are documented in `ai-os/PROMPT_GATEWAY_2026-07-25.yaml`, registered in `MASTER_INDEX.yaml` (`registries.prompt_gateway`) and the knowledge engine (KE-20260725-054113-72af, KE-20260725-054119-28b3).

**Explicitly NOT done (named, not silently folded in):** Temporal (workflow orchestration), OPA (policy), Qdrant (vector store), and local-model-inference hosting — all named out-of-scope in this task's own constraints. The rest of the Owner's 19-engine OWNER_ENGINE spec beyond `PROMPT_PROCESSING_PIPELINE` + `CONTEXT_MANAGEMENT_PIPELINE` + a slice of `COMPRESSION_STACK` remains a real, separate, uninventoried gap — I don't have the full verbatim 19-engine list in this task's context, so I documented that honestly rather than guessing at it.

No systemd daemon was installed — the staged template assumed a nonexistent `veridian` user and a named-pipe streaming daemon with no real producer in this system; reasoning is in the YAML doc.
